name: blooddrop
description: BloodDrop — local blood & emergency donor alert network (React, Express, Supabase/PostGIS)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c red,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.reset:data: rm -f backend/.data/db.json && echo 'mock data reset — restart the backend to reseed'
